questions.question_text: Match the drugs in A to E which inhibit the following enzymes: 1. Carbonic anhydrase, 2. Dihydrofolatesynthtase, 3. $\beta$-lactumase, 4. Acetylcholinesterase. Inhibitors: A. Dicloxacillin, B. Physostigmine, C. Acetazolamide, D. Sulphanilamide, E. Ibuprofen

questions.question_text: The undesirable effects of the antibiotics are listed in A to E. match them: 1. Tetracycline, 2. Strptomycin, 3. Chloramphenicol, 4. Rifampicin. Effects: A. Gray-baby syndrome, B. Discolouration of teech, C. Jaundice, D. Obesity, E. Ototoxicity

questions.question_text: Absorption frequency ($cm^{-1}$) in IR spectroscopy for carbonyl group are given in A to E match them: 1. -COCl, 2. -O-C(=O)-, 3. -CHO, 4. -CONH2. Frequencies: A. 1720, B. 1735, C. 1750, D. 1776, E. 1812
